1	/**
     2	 * Repository Detail View — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the Repository Overview page at `#/repositories/:id`, showing a
     5	 * table of every workspace across every project that contains the given
     6	 * repository. Each row displays contextual Project and Workspace columns
     7	 * alongside the shared Branch, Status, and Actions cells.
     8	 *
     9	 * ## Data loading flow
    10	 *
    11	 * 1. `api.repositories.get(id)`  — fetch repository metadata (name, URL).
    12	 * 2. `api.projects.list()`       — fetch all projects.
    13	 * 3. Per project: `api.projects.get(pid)` — filter to those containing repoId.
    14	 * 4. Per matching project: `api.workspaces.list(pid)` — list workspaces.
    15	 * 5. Per workspace: `api.status.get(pid, wid)` — extract the single repo's status.
    16	 * 6. `api.config.webserverUrl.get()` — fetch webserver URL once.
    17	 *
    18	 * Steps 2–5 use `Promise.allSettled` so individual project/workspace fetch
    19	 * failures do not abort the entire load. Failed fetches are silently skipped;
    20	 * when at least one fetch failed but others succeeded a warning toast is shown.
    21	 *
    22	 * ## Router injection
    23	 *
    24	 * Exports `setRouter(router)` so that `app.js` can inject the router for
    25	 * programmatic navigation. The `_router` variable is null-guarded everywhere.
    26	 *
    27	 * ## No polling
    28	 *
    29	 * This view does not auto-poll (refreshing all workspaces across all projects
    30	 * on a timer would be too expensive). A manual "Refresh" button force-fetches
    31	 * all status data and updates rows in-place.
    32	 *
    33	 * @module repository-detail
    34	 */
    35	
    36	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    37	import { showToast }         from '../components/toast.js';
    38	import { buildRepoStatusCells, updateRepoStatusCells } from '../components/repo-status-cells.js';
    39	import { normaliseRepo, normaliseProject, normaliseWorkspace } from '../utils/normalise.js';
    40	
    41	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42	// Router reference — injected from app.js via setRouter()
    43	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44	
    45	/** @type {import('../router.js').Router|null} */
    46	let _router = null;
    47	
    48	/**
    49	 * Inject the router instance so repository-detail can navigate programmatically.
    50	 * Called from `app.js` before the router starts.
    51	 *
    52	 * @param {import('../router.js').Router} router
    53	 */
    54	export function setRouter(router) {
    55	    _router = router;
    56	}
    57	
    58	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59	// Constants
    60	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61	
    62	/** The workspace ID that is always treated as STABLE (no branch switching). */
    63	const STABLE_WS_ID = 'STABLE';
    64	
    65	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    66	// Loading helper
    67	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    68	
    69	/**
    70	 * Render a loading spinner into `el`.
    71	 *
    72	 * @param {HTMLElement} el
    73	 * @param {string} [label]
    74	 */
    75	function showLoading(el, label = 'Loading…') {
    76	    el.innerHTML = '';
    77	    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    78	    wrapper.className = 'loading-indicator';
    79	    wrapper.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    80	
    81	    const spinner = document.createElement('span');
    82	    spinner.className = 'spinner';
    83	    spinner.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    84	    wrapper.appendChild(spinner);
    85	
    86	    const labelEl = document.createElement('span');
    87	    labelEl.textContent = label;
    88	    wrapper.appendChild(labelEl);
    89	
    90	    el.appendChild(wrapper);
    91	}
    92	
    93	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94	// Row descriptor type
    95	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96	
    97	/**
    98	 * @typedef {Object} WorkspaceRowDescriptor
    99	 * @property {string}      pid           - Project ID.
   100	 * @property {string}      projectName   - Human-readable project name.
